svg.aria-label: Why Campus Hub Isn't a One-Shot CRUD App

g.text: Why Campus Hub Isn't a One-Shot CRUD App
What a single-prompt CRUD generator produces vs. the concurrent, event-driven & cloud engineering verified in this repo
Double-books assets, bypasses quotas, deadlocks on bundles
Future bookings silently orphaned; students arrive to broken gear
Disabled user keeps booking until 8h token expires
BCrypt truncates >72B; no magic-byte check; manual page refresh
Controllers return @Entity; cross-module repo imports everywhere
Local vs UTC cloud drift; Spring proxy traps hidden in interfaces
5-10 unit tests passing on H2; zero real-DB race coverage
Hidden IDOR leaks, stack traces in 500s, untested mutant branches
Manual ZIP/JAR deploys, SSH port 22 open, zero IaC or rollback
Sorted Asset locks → pg_advisory_xact_lock(1, uid) → fresh role
SameModel → SameCategory (same lab first); REQUIRES_NEW per booking
Live Kill-Switch, Rotating QR Pass & Cross-Tab SSE
Scalar findActiveRole bypasses L1 cache; HMAC-SHA256 30s QR pass
Magic-byte photo checks; SSE 20s :hb (<30s CloudFront), instant drop
api-only cross-module contracts, acyclic DAG, DTO records only
Injected Clock (Europe/Bucharest), bans default api methods & Boot 2/3
DemoFlowIT (10-step E2E) + SecurityPassIT (runtime admin route scan)
pg_stat_activity lock proofs, 7-test IdempotencyServiceIT, PIT mutation testing
3-stage CVE-patched image; private RDS + CloudFront prefix-list SG
IMDSv2 + SSM-only (no SSH); immutable GitHub OIDC deploy.yml
Verified on main: 251 merged PRs · 283 cross-team peer reviews · 40 real bugs closed with regression tests · 29,619 test lines (2.16x backend prod)
